action.command:
python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from phase3_generative_loop import mutate_composition, DOPANT_POOL
print('DOPANT_POOL:', DOPANT_POOL)
for formula in ['SiC', 'GaN', 'AlN', 'BN', 'Si0.8C0.2']:
    out = mutate_composition(formula, mutation_rate=0.1)
    # Verify normalization
    import re
    parsed = re.findall(r'([A-Z][a-z]*)(\d*\.?\d*)', out)
    total = sum(float(c) if c else 1.0 for _, c in parsed)
    print(f'{formula} -> {out} (sum={total:.4f})')
"
